prompt: Make an accurate fine contour museum plate of the Song Iron Pagoda at Kaifeng, using photo2 for entire tower profile and photo3 for lower facade details. Image1 Longmen Buddha is STYLE ONLY. Exactly THIRTEEN eaves/storeys: long narrow octagonal tower with an extremely gradual taper and shallow upturned tiled eaves. The lowest storey is taller and broader; then twelve upper eaves with the small pointed top roof and bead finial. Count all13 including top roof, not14. Preserve actual proportions, arched/small openings alternating on faces, intricate glazed imitations of wooden brackets simplified to clean outlines, and the small lower entrance in photo3. Tower only, fullheight with3facetsvisible, nearfront eye-level elevation. Remove all street scenery, lanterns, flowers, people, trees and signs. Do not darken ceramic surfaces: this is NOT a dark silhouette or photo filter, it is sparse precise black lines on pure white. Most wall surfaces blank, a few framed tile motifs only, NO dense grid of every tile and NO hatching. Fine thin line quality and breathing space like first image. Portrait1024x1536, entire tower within ample margin, no labels or words.

site_recommendation.name: 开封铁塔
site_recommendation.lede: 十三层密集的檐线缓缓收向塔顶。开封铁塔并非铁铸，深褐色琉璃砖让这座宋塔获得了沿用至今的名字。
facts: 祐国寺塔建于北宋皇祐元年（1049），为八角十三层琉璃砖塔。
塔面以模制琉璃砖拼砌斗栱、门窗和装饰，密集檐口形成稳定的节奏。
图版以完整塔身照片为主、底层近照为补充，保留十三层，不复原前身木塔。
